title: pteracanthus urophyllus
intro: Pteracanthus urophyllus, commonly known as the "Tongue of Heaven" or "Uprolling Pteracanthus", is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia. The Pteracanthus urophyllus plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, colds, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include astringent, anti-diarrheal, and expectorant properties, making it useful for soothing coughs and addressing digestive issues. Bioactive constituents of the Pteracanthus urophyllus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
